nodes.rationale: Cross-references are never inverted and shared-code co-occurrence never proves interchangeability; superseded/restricted claims cannot authorise unconditional interchange.

nodes.rationale: Oil is only recommended with exact applicable verified specs and current actual-product approvals matching catalog fingerprint and viscosity; otherwise insufficient data is returned.
